decisions.reason: The coolant cleaning centrifuge remains tightly linked to our filtration and process-media know-how, so our strong absorptive capacity and service feedback make continued refinement more attractive than withdrawal.

The coolant nozzles line is a highly related modular complement to our coolant systems, and its multiple models fit our broad portfolio and can be improved efficiently through existing engineering and customer learning.

The scraper belt chip conveyor is close to our conveying and automation base, and in a growing market we would usually retain such a product while learning from applications and adapting it within the portfolio.
The magnetic belt chip conveyor builds directly on our established chip-handling and conveyor competences, so we are well placed to assimilate market feedback and keep developing it commercially.

The hinged belt chip conveyor is strongly related to our existing conveyor business, and a large R&D-active machinery firm like ours would typically keep this type of adjacent product and iterate rather than exit quickly.
